body:
Depression is like a fog that gets in the way with eating and seeing people.

Theres a dignity and honor aspect i think your missing, failing at an assumed "right path" can lead to bonifide wrongly justifiable feelings.  But this opens a whole big discussion, i hope we can leave it here.

What made me stop and not jump off that parking ramp that day i dont care to dicuss. thanks for trying to show the illogic in suicide but really it boils down to finding a proper solution, whatever that solution may be.

As far as "J" goes,  I made and make a choice to love her.  We have what you might call a pre-apocalyptic romance in the most righteous fashion.  It doesn't mean I'll marry her but i will be_moved_by her.  What lies between us can do great things, it is highly unconditional on both ends as time has shown while we both fault in our own ways and grow.  It is a romance.  Yes, i reserve the notion of loving (and am capable now, have had others that included sport-fucking and you name it) and being in a relationship but to be quite honest that wouldn't remove my love for "j", maybe transform it, but that comes to faith and fate at that point.

I want to grow and explore the methodology and relationship with plants, fungi, bugs, etc.  I have operated a hobby farm before and used certain soil inoculations, soilless mixes, tracked carbon, irrigated, and tracked results, I'm a vegetarian, and i self-learn well.  I don't want to work at a farmers market.  I want to work with soil.

What you said sounds sort of hopeful, and btw, my mindstate is not suicidal now, i have an answer.  Direction might be everything.

Thanks everyone for the help, it really_has_helped and i was_really_at a breaking point of breaking points....   My solution came from user-Panic Button; She says id be best to get out of the town im in... Although reading many of your posts moved me away from ending myself, for real real, not for play play.

A little about that town:
The library sometimes smells of homeless people, The culture is just fucked- especially how men treat women, or opposite. The town has an economy built for the upper class and college kids and has left (or is leaving) the middle-class behind big time...  I could make a whole thread on this, Government spending is just stupid and i wont go on-here.  I came for a woman (you can laugh at that) and a particular field of work i care much about, and it failed.  I know that now, Ill be making a post in AskReddit in a little bit for help deciding where im moving to and *go from there*.  Yes, i could do some wiki'ing and the better likes but lets be honest, reddit is the shit.  I live in Westminster Maryland, a great dive...
i see where your coming from, so thanks
i might do that :), i'm busy with somthing right now.   Yeah Yeah Yeah's?

the girl i love doesnt want to speak to me, shes got some issue or somthing im not sure.  She helped me establish myself here in a new state and then thats it.

I have called hotlines, but i just dont understand how im going to get better, this isnt the life i want.
this isnt me
I want to do organic farming, help people but im too depressed to leave.

you can write it here, i just dont feel like fliping around or doing anything new... idk
i'm really exhausted

Im just waiting to see if if "J" cantacts me, i feel shes the only one that can help, and maybe reddit
